newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN INSIDER DEALING AMENDMENTS EXPECTED BY AUGUST 1.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN INSIDER DEALING AMENDMENTS EXPECTED BY AUGUST 1.

text.p: The Latvian securities commission (LSC) on Friday said it plans to have amendments to the securities law on insider dealing passed by August 1.
"Amendments providing for all combinations (of insider dealing) should be passed by August 1," Viktors Gustsons, the chairman of the LSC, told a news conference.
The amendments would be passed by the government during the parliament summer holidays under clause 81 of the constitution.
"This will bring the Latvian Securities law, earlier highly evaluated in a World Bank analysis, in line with all the first level EU directives," he added.
Gustsons named insider trading, which distorts the real price situation, as one of the biggest potential risks in any emerging market, including Latvia's.
